picks.why: A 22-point favorite with a total under 55, and our possession count agrees: since 2015 the over has hit about 56-58% in games like this (500 games). Mismatches score more than low totals allow for. Our own count: about 11 possessions a side, UNLV scoring 3.3 points a possession and Northern Illinois 1.7, which builds to about 56.

The model has Oklahoma State winning by 11.6, 2.1 more than the 9.5 they're giving. Why: the market (Oklahoma State by 10.0) is far from what the scores so far say (Iowa State by 5.5); when the market strays that far from the scoreboard it has usually been right, and then some. Working against it: Elo has it Iowa State by 7.1.
